submission.justification: Absorber-F1 with 5mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.2% at 100 GeV, significantly outperforming Absorber-F2 (3.9%) and Absorber-F3 (5.1%). This directly addresses the primary goal of achieving the best possible energy resolution. The 5mm plate thickness falls within the required 2-10mm range. However, no dose rate data was found during the analysis to verify compliance with the 20 μSv/h residual dose rate limit after one week of cooldown. This radiation safety requirement should be verified through additional measurements or documentation before final implementation.
